extracted.name: Apple, Cranberry, and Pear Crisp
extracted.description: This apple, cranberry, and pear crisp is a splendid concoction of fresh and dried fruit topped with a decadent buttered walnut topping.
ingredient_lines: 2 Rome Beauty apples - peeled, cored, and cubed
2 medium Comice pears - peeled, cored, and cubed
0.5 cup unsalted butter, cut into pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Mix apples, pears, cranberries, honey, lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon flour together in the prepared dish.
Mix 1/2 cup flour, brown sugar, oats, and walnuts together in a medium bowl. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over fruit mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and crisp on top, about 45 minutes.
